tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Search reviewed profiles and return matching products, official sources and canonical profile links. No results means only that the database has no match.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Return a reviewed profile with representative equipment, buyer questions, sources and available credentials evidence at its original evidence level. Undisclosed information is marked unknown.

tools.name: prepare_rfq
tools.description: Compare selected profiles, their evidence and questions to confirm, with the existing RFQ worksheet and relevant guides. This does not calculate, rate suppliers, request quotes or send enquiries.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_supplier" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
